title: Releasing Money Back to the Party on a Cancelled Vacation Package
content:
The money returned on a cancelled vacation package goes back to the form of payment the package was paid from. A party whose package under one of Wanderlane's Vacation Package Products has been given up may ask for what that package still owes them to be taken back to the card it was paid from.

The money returned on a cancelled package is settled only after its ledger carries the cancellation penalty withheld for the places the party gave up.

## What the release does

The release puts a single payout line on that package's ledger for the amount released, dated the day it is raised, and reduces the net money standing to the package by that amount, so the party's package statement shows the money leaving the package and coming back to them.

## How the release is made

The tool `release_package_refund_313c063d` is unlocked and handed over to the customer themselves, who runs it on their own package; the desk does not run it for them.

## What it is given

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `bundle_package_id` | the internal reference number identifying which of the party's vacation packages the money is being returned from, as carried on the package record the desk reads out to them | an identifier, with no fixed candidates |
| `refund_amount_usd` | the money coming back to the party's card | a positive USD amount with 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent, with no currency symbol, thousands separator or sign; the payout line itself carries it as money leaving the package |

## What comes back

A plain confirmation sentence naming the new package ledger line reference, the package the money was returned from and the amount in US dollars to two decimal places. That sentence, carrying a ledger line reference, is the party's record of what was returned; no other value is returned.
